_comment: Light jobs beside a series: well-known people from a community, ranked by how many readers already know the name, tied back to the places of their lives with a checked quote per tie, and told as short sub-stories. Asked for by the author 2026-10-02: Jimi Hendrix and Quincy Jones both went to Garfield High School, and Jones played on Jackson Street where Ray Charles played; few of those places are designated landmarks, so famous names can bring readers to places no designation recorded. Shallow and cheap on purpose: an encyclopedia article and at most two more sources per person. Steps: OFFSPIN.md. Read by tools/fame.py.

caps._people: How many people a run tells. The ranking decides who, never the model's sense of fame.
caps._candidatesToRead: fame.py screen reads this many top-ranked articles (plus every seed) looking for an identity statement. In the first Black Seattle screen, 5 of the top 40 qualified, so 120 is the default; raise it with --top when too few qualify. About 30 seconds per 40 articles, cached.
caps._vignetteWords: A sub-story's range. Over the ceiling is a hard finding; under the floor a note.

runs.label: Famous Black Seattleites and their places
runs._seeds: Named by the author, 2026-10-02. Seeds are always screened, whatever their rank.
runs._categories: Wikipedia categories whose members are ranked. A category says a person has a Seattle connection; it never says who they are. Identity comes only from a statement in the article (identityTerms), and a second reader confirms the statement is about the person.
runs._identityTerms: Phrases, not the bare word: "Black" alone matched "Black Hole Sun", "Black Sabbath" and "Black Diamond" in the first screen (2026-10-02). Wikipedia rarely states an athlete's race, so some well-known Black Seattleites will not qualify from the article alone; the author can add them as seeds with a source that does.

runs._status: Named by the author for later (2026-10-02): Bruce Lee for Immigrant Seattle. Not a series yet; identity for immigrants is a different statement (where they were born, when they came), so the terms below are a start, to be checked against the first screen.
runs.label: Famous immigrant Seattleites and their places
